Matcha Green Tea Granita
By: Marla Meridith
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:09pm

Ingredients




1 tablespoon Matcha Green Tea Powder
Splash of Milk, Soymilk, Rice Milk, 
Splash of water
Sweetener to taste: I use my Sweetleaf Stevia Drops (English Toffee of Ice
Optional: A splash of Vanilla or Coconut extract

Preparation

1 Place in blender.  I use my Rocket Blender .  Blend it all together and Enjoy!!!  Icy, Creamy, Smooth!

About


I love quick, easy, healthy, sweet treats with no guilt!  This satisfies the sweet tooth and the Matcha is delicious!!
Please view for more info:
http://familyfreshcooking.wordpress.com/2009/08/30/matcha-green-tea-smoothie/
